newsitem.title: USA: Wachovia forms global services division.
newsitem.headline: Wachovia forms global services division.

text.p: Wachovia Corp said Wednesday it has formed a global services division to help its customers perform better in the international marketplace.
The bank holding company said the new division is now a part of its unit, Wachovia Corporate Services Inc (WCSI).

"The mission of the new division is to significantly expand Wachovia's role in providing services that our customers and prospects need to fulfill their growing connections and commitments to international markets," said Hugh Durden, president of WCSI.

John Chalk, an executive vice president at WCSI, will be manager of the new division. Chalk most recently served as head of Wachovia's U.S. corporate division and has been with the company for 18 years.
